name: Retail Monitor
prompt: A retail dashboard showing daily sales, a map of transactions across the USA, and a table of top customers.

thought_process.interpretation: The user wants a retail performance dashboard for monitoring sales metrics. I've adopted the 'Executive Summary' archetype, focusing on high-level KPIs, temporal trends (daily sales), geographic distribution (USA map), and specific top-performer details (top customers).
assumed_from_scratch: State-level geographic data (mocked as the provided schema lacked state/region columns)
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A 'geo_enrichment' skill or a standard 'usa_states' reference dataset would help provide real geographic mappings when the primary table only contains user/order IDs.
